name: R13
band_note: mean of blouse and sweater entry $470 (women's price pass, 2026-10-13)
why: Distressed jeans, oversized knits, shirts, leather jackets and platform boots, jeans around $495 and boots around $1,300, sold through its own store, site and department stores.

quote.q: It always stays with me, that feeling and sensibility, and it’s also sort of timeless. Punk and grunge in different ways still exist in our culture.
quote.src: Fashionista, "The Designer Behind R13 Emerges from Anonymity With an Aggressively '90s Runway Debut"

opview: “It always stays with me, that feeling and sensibility, and it’s also sort of timeless. Punk and grunge in different ways still exist in our culture.” — Chris Leba, founder, Fashionista, "The Designer Behind R13 Emerges from Anonymity With an Aggressively '90s Runway Debut"

facts_read.source: brand site (collections, New Icons, legal terms); Fashionista 2016-02-11; nordstrom.com search; Vinted catalogue; TRR designer index; B Lab directory; GOTS database

price_read.sublines: R13 women's ready-to-wear, denim and shoes (vendors R13, R13 Denim and 'RATT', which carries R13-labelled styles); EXCLUDED: men's shoes, accessories, gift cards

doors.note: Stockist feed 227 rows (103 US), all multibrand stockists except 2 'R13 Store' rows: 34 Howard St New York (US) and Réel Dept Store Shanghai (China, not counted). Footer 'R13 Flagship' page shows New York only.

fibre.sample: stratified sample of 80 of 214 women's styles (419 feed records; product types RTW-WOMENS and DENIM-WOMENS = 336 listings, collapsed on the style name before th

craft_evidence.mills: no — cloth origins only ('Italian cupro', 'Italian virgin wool blend', 'Japanese' denim)
craft_evidence.madein: 0% on the page; country sits only in hidden product tags (sample: China 42, US 17, Italy 15, none 6 of 80)
craft_evidence.heritage: no about page on the store
craft_evidence.reasoning: The store has no about or making page and no product page states where it is made; country codes exist only as feed tags shoppers do not see. Cloth origins are named but no mill. Nothing verifiable about making: 1.
